request:
I run a susu group at the market in Kumasi and I want to stop keeping the records in an exercise book. I need to start a group and add the members, each with their name and phone number. Every round, members pay in their contribution, and I record who paid, for which round, and how much in cedis. At the end of a round one member collects the pot, and the pot is everything that was paid in for that round, nothing more and nothing less. Each round has only one collector, and a member can collect only once, so if someone has already collected, they cannot collect again. Once a round has been collected, nobody can pay more into that round, and a round where nobody has paid anything cannot be collected. Contributions must be more than zero. For any member I want a statement showing how much they have paid in altogether and how much they have received. I also want to see the list of members and the collections made so far.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can each person pay any amount (including paying more than once in the same round)?
A: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
Q: Must rounds go in order (round 2 opens only after round 1 is collected), or can payments be recorded for any round number at any time?
A: No preference: you decide.
Q: Does the person collecting a round have to be a member who paid into that round, or can any member of the group collect?
A: No preference: you decide.

Where the client has no preference or did not answer, choose the simplest option and add nothing they did not ask for (no logins, PINs or extra required fields).
summary:
I've built the app in `app.py`. All 6 automated tests pass. Your records are saved in a file called `susu.db` in the same folder.

**Endpoints**
- `POST /groups` starts a group. It needs a group name.
- `POST /groups/{groupId}/members` adds a member. Both a name and a phone number are required, and blank ones are refused.
- `GET /groups/{groupId}/members` shows the list of members with their names and phone numbers.
- `POST /groups/{groupId}/payments` records a payment: which member, which round, and how many cedis.
  - The amount must be more than zero, with at most 2 decimal places (pesewas).
  - Members can pay any amount and more than once in the same round.
  - It refuses someone who isn't a member of this group, and any payment into a round that has already been collected.
- `POST /groups/{groupId}/rounds/{roundNumber}/collection` records who collects that round. The app works out the pot itself as exactly the total paid into that round. If someone sends a pot amount, it is ignored. It refuses:
  - a round nobody has paid into
  - a round that already has a collector
  - a member who has already collected before
  - someone who isn't a member of this group
- `GET /groups/{groupId}/collections` shows each collection so far: the round, who collected, and the pot.
- `GET /groups/{groupId}/members/{memberId}/statement` shows one member's total paid in and total received.

**The two choices you left to me**
- **Round order:** rounds don't have to go in order. You can record a payment for any round number at any time.
- **Who can collect:** any member of the group can collect a round, even if they didn't pay into it.

**Your question still to answer:** anyone who can reach the app can see the member list, including phone numbers. I haven't added logins or passwords because you didn't ask for them. Tell me if you want them.

plan.summary: This plan replaces your exercise book for a susu group. You can start a group, add members with their name and phone number, and record each payment: who paid, for which round, and how many cedis. Members may pay any amount and may pay more than once in the same round. When a round ends, you record which member collects. The system works out the pot itself as exactly the total paid into that round, so it can never be more or less. You can see the list of members, the list of collections so far, and a statement for any member showing their total paid in and total received. You left two choices to me, and I picked the simplest option each time. First, rounds do not have to go in order: you can record a payment for any round number at any time. Second, any member of the group can collect a round, even if they did not pay into it. Nothing in your request was unsafe or outside the backend, so nothing was left out. One question for you: members' phone numbers will be stored and shown in the member list. Should anyone else besides you be able to see them? I have not added any privacy controls, logins or passwords, because you did not ask for them. Please tell me if you want them.

data.name: Collection
fields: pot amount in cedis (worked out automatically as the total paid into that round)

endpoints.does: Adds a member to the group with their name and phone number.
Shows the list of all members in the group.
Records that a member paid an amount in cedis for a particular round.
Records which member collects the pot for this round. The pot is set automatically to everything paid into that round.
Shows all collections made so far: the round, who collected, and how much the pot was.
Shows one member's statement: how much they have paid in altogether and how much they have received.

rules: Refuse a payment of zero or less. Every payment must be more than zero cedis.
Refuse a payment or collection for someone who is not a member of that group.
Refuse a payment into a round that has already been collected.
Refuse a collection for a round where nobody has paid anything.
Refuse a second collection for a round that already has a collector. Each round has only one collector.
Refuse a collection by a member who has already collected before. Each member can collect only once.
The pot cannot be typed in by hand. It is always exactly the total paid into that round, nothing more and nothing less.
Refuse to add a member without both a name and a phone number.
